app.title: UC World Model
app.description: Unofficial student-made 3D map of the buildings of the University of Canterbury's Ilam and Dovedale campuses and its Arts Centre location in Christchurch. Not affiliated with the University of Canterbury.
app.ogDescription: See the buildings of UC's Ilam and Dovedale campuses and its Arts Centre location on a 3D model of Christchurch, drawn from OpenStreetMap. Unofficial; not affiliated with the University of Canterbury.
app.noscript: UC World Model is an unofficial 3D map of the buildings of the University of Canterbury's Ilam and Dovedale campuses and its Arts Centre location in Christchurch. It needs JavaScript and WebGL to run. It is not affiliated with the University of Canterbury.
app.loadError: The map data could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
app.noWebgl: This browser could not start WebGL, so the 3D map is not shown. Search for buildings still works.
app.sceneLabel: 3D map of UC's campuses in Christchurch. Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag or two fingers to move.

about.unofficial: UC World Model is made by a student for students. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or maintained by Te Whare Wānanga o Waitaha, the University of Canterbury, and it uses no UC logo. Its colours are the project's own, the same for every school, and none is taken from UC. It shows the buildings of UC's Ilam and Dovedale campuses and its Arts Centre location only, from OpenStreetMap. For anything that matters, check UC's own campus maps and your own timetable.

limits.timetable: No class times. UC's public timetable planner is on a site whose robots.txt asks every automated visitor to leave it alone, and UC's copyright page asks for its written permission before material on its webpages is copied, so the site does not take them. Nothing here is made up to fill the gap.
limits.timetableLoaded: Class times come from a snapshot of UC's timetable taken on {date}. Rooms and times change during the semester; your own timetable is the authority.
limits.scheduled: A timetabled class is not the same as an occupied room. Classes are cancelled, moved and held online, and rooms are used for things that are not on the timetable.
limits.heights: Each of UC's buildings is one block on its OpenStreetMap outline, with no floors. Its height comes from OpenStreetMap: its height tag where it has one; else its number of levels, {height} m each; else 6.5 m, or 10 m for a building over 900 m², the defaults of the surrounding buildings. The building card says which. None of these heights is surveyed: most of UC's buildings have a number of levels in OpenStreetMap and stand that many storeys high, and the rest stand at a default. The windows and the rim round each roof are drawn by rule and say nothing about the real walls and roofs. The ground's heights come from Land Information New Zealand's 8 m elevation model of 2012, which is drawn from contours: it is smooth bare ground, with sharp peaks a few metres low. A building stands on the ground under its middle; on a slope its uphill side goes into the hill and a footing fills the gap below the other side.
limits.rooms: No floors and no rooms. UC publishes no floor or room outlines. Its campus map lists its teaching rooms by building, but UC's copyright page asks for its written permission before material on its webpages is copied, so the site does not show them. So each building is one block, and nothing inside it is drawn.
limits.campuses: The Ilam and Dovedale campuses and the Arts Centre city location are modelled. Dovedale, west of Ilam, and the Arts Centre, in the central city, each stand in their own patch of surroundings: the streets and buildings between them and Ilam are not drawn. A building is drawn as UC's only where OpenStreetMap tags it as a university building, or names UC as its operator, and gives it a name; any other stands among the surrounding buildings, with no name. So the Arts Centre shows one building, Music & Classics, which OpenStreetMap names UC as the operator of; the Arts Centre's other buildings are not tagged as UC's. Halls of residence and childcare centres stay unnamed among the surroundings. The Nelson campus is not modelled, since OpenStreetMap tags none of the buildings at its address as UC's, and Manawa, the field stations and UC's other places are not modelled either.
limits.context: Surrounding buildings, streets and trees come from OpenStreetMap. Where it maps a building in parts or gives a roof a shape, those are drawn, the roof in a simplified form. Where a height is not mapped, a default is used. In the walker views every building, UC's and the rest, is drawn with storeys from its height, windows, and walls of plaster, brick, concrete, stone, glass or weatherboard chosen by rule from where it stands; none of it says what a real building looks like, and there are no doors, since none are mapped. The ground there is drawn by rule as well, on the streets, paths, railways, parks and ponds OpenStreetMap maps: asphalt with white lines, kerbs, paving slabs, steps, sleepers and rails, lawns and water, and grass and bare earth elsewhere. Its widths, lines and kerbs say nothing about the real ones, and there are no crossings, arrows or signs, since none are mapped. A tree standing alone is where OpenStreetMap maps it; its size and shape are drawn by rule, and in the walker views so are its leaves, its bark and the way it sways in a light breeze, the same every day; none of it says what kind of tree it is. Trees OpenStreetMap tags as deciduous turn in April and May, stand bare from June to August and come into leaf in September and October; the rest are drawn evergreen. Trees inside woodland areas are scattered for decoration.
limits.walker: The walker is a made-up figure, not a person: it stands for nobody, and nothing about where it goes leaves your browser. Its walks are planned round the buildings on the map and along OpenStreetMap's paths and streets, off motorways except over footbridges. Doors and entrances are not mapped, so a walk to a building ends beside its nearest wall, and it passes gates, fences and kerbs the map does not have. Its body is the "Animated Human" model by Quaternius, given to the public domain (CC0); its stance, trainers, hair, mouth, backpack and umbrella are drawn here by rule, in the project's own colours, none taken from UC. Where a building or a tree hides it, its shape shows through. An agent can steer it on your own computer through the scripts in the source code.
limits.subjects: No course list. UC publishes its subject codes on its webpages and its courses in its Course Information System, but UC's copyright page asks for its written permission before material on its webpages is copied, so the site does not take them.
limits.calendar: No semester dates. UC publishes its key dates, but UC's copyright page asks for its written permission before material on its webpages is copied, so the site does not take them, and the time panel moves the sun and the light only.
limits.daylight: The sun stands where it does over UC's Ilam campus at the date and time shown, from NOAA's published solar-position equations; below 10° above the horizon it is drawn at 10°, so that shadows stay on the map. Night falls as the sun goes from 6° above the horizon to 8° below. In Now mode the cloud, rain and fog follow Open-Meteo's current weather for UC's Ilam campus, and the falling rain is drawn by rule; Preview shows a clear sky, because past and future weather are not known here.

about.privacy: The site has no accounts and sets no cookies. It holds no names of people. Only the copy at campusworldmodel.com is counted: there Cloudflare, which serves the site, counts page views and visits with its Web Analytics. It stores nothing in your browser and does not record which building you look at; a content blocker may stop it. If the weather line is shown, your browser asks Open-Meteo for the current weather at UC's Ilam campus; nothing about you is sent beyond that request. A walk with the walker stays in your browser: where it goes, what it says and what it wears are not sent anywhere.

room.noTimetableWhy: UC's class times are not taken by this site, so it cannot say what is scheduled here. See About for details.

search.hint: Type a building's name, for example Puaka-James Hight or Jack Erskine. Rooms and courses are not shown: see About.
search.noResultsHint: UC's buildings are found by the names OpenStreetMap gives them; two are named by their street and number, such as 47 Creyke Road. Building names work with or without macrons.

travel.go: Travel to {name}. This leaves UC World Model.
